envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: a guard stopped asking its judge after three timeouts and stayed dark for the whole session although the judge had recovered; the concept said the guard judges every turn it can but did not say a failed judge is asked again, and the realization that passed assay held the latch
envelope.cause: operator approved fixing the dark judge as a one-unit plan

payload.gloss: a guard binds exactly the agents whose composition includes it, on every supported harness, and judges every turn it fires on; where its judge cannot run, it lets the turn through and says so, never silently, and it asks the judge again once the judge may have recovered, so a passing outage never leaves the guard unjudged for the rest of a session. Where a harness cannot tell which agent is running, the guard is carried as a stated rule instead and the operator is told; a guard that fires and judges nothing never ships.
